facts.fact: 浴室水龙头滴答一上午，Eden 烦到想徒手拆水管， texting Gemma 调来她姐姐 Misty 修理。
facts.anchor: My bathroom tap has been dripping non-stop all morning and I’m so close to ripping it out of the wall myself.

facts.fact: 姐妹俩逼问下，Eden 磕磕绊绊承认了：我喜欢他。
面对「他可能是连环杀手」的玩笑，Gemma 撂话：那人身上没有杀人的因子。
facts.anchor: With all due respect, I don’t think that man has it in him to kill someone.

facts.fact: Eden 与 Honours coordinator Maddison Harvey 约在同一咖啡馆谈来年规划与经费。
facts.anchor: Maddison Harvey, my Honours coordinator, agreed to meet me here to discuss my plans for next year, and the future.

facts.fact: 原书笔误照录：同一章内 Maddison 与 Madison 两种拼写并存（本行作 Madison）。
facts.anchor: Madison slides into the chair across from me.

facts.fact: Maddison 曾是 Eden 暑期有机化学导师，深知她与 Literature 的烂账。
facts.anchor: Maddison was my tutor for organic chemistry over the summer after Literature and I parted on not-so-great terms.

facts.fact: 研究项目导师 Edward Zhao，执掌该实验室二十余年，一作文章惊人。
facts.anchor: My supervisor for this project is Edward Zhao, who’s been running this specific lab for over twenty years.

facts.fact: Eden 的项目申请聚焦：为多种疾病建早期检测流程，让世界上更多人受益。
facts.anchor: The ability to have an early detection process for a variety of diseases and illnesses would be invaluable for so many people around the world
